assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production character cutout for the Korean web app "Object Court", used at 200–320 px.
Primary request: Redesign the app's blue water-bottle defendant into a beautifully simple, cohesive premium 3D toy mascot. The BOTTLE ITSELF is the character, not a rectangle containing a picture. One standalone full-body character only.
Subject: a reusable rounded cobalt / dusty cornflower blue water bottle, dark navy screw cap, short rounded shoulders, familiar tall cylindrical bottle silhouette, a couple of tiny pale scuff marks on the lower side to suggest a well-loved object. Two small dark oval eyes directly on the front of the blue bottle, tiny gently hopeful smile, very subtle raised worried brows. Tiny short rounded blue arms seamlessly attached to the body, small navy oval feet. Left arm resting by its side, right hand lifted slightly in a gentle pleading gesture. Understated friendly face; expressive through pose, not exaggerated eyes.
Style/medium: exquisite minimal 3D designer toy / soft matte resin sculpture, continuous sculpted surfaces, restrained soft studio lighting, delicate ambient occlusion, smooth soft bevels. Clean editorial art direction. Muted blue and navy palette, cream eye highlights only.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered, full bottle and limbs entirely visible with 12 percent clear breathing room all around. Mostly front view, subtly three dimensional. Readable silhouette and face even at thumbnail sizes.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, no environment and no floor, no opaque backdrop, no fake checkerboard.
Constraints: no words, typography, logos, watermark, accessories, costume, courtroom furniture, frame, pedestal, additional character, human figure. No giant white googly eyes, gloves, thin stick limbs, thick black outlines, shiny plastic, exaggerated smile or busy texture. Render only the complete blue bottle mascot as a clean transparent PNG cutout.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: second production character cutout for Korean "Object Court" app.
Input images: Image 1 is ONLY a style reference for the companion blue bottle character. Match its soft matte 3D material, tiny dark oval face, sculpted stubby limbs, friendly understated expression and premium designer toy finish. Create the EARPHONE character described below; do not reproduce a bottle.
Primary request: One single anthropomorphic wireless earbud charging case, with its own two earbuds seated in the open lid/case, the whole assembly forming ONE coherent character. A warm ivory rounded-square squat charging case is the body with two tiny navy oval eyes and a tiny slightly hopeful smile directly on its front, minuscule worried brows. The lid is open, making two recognizable white wireless earbuds visible above the rim as part of the object. A tiny subdued indicator dot low on the front. Short sculpted ivory arms, two little charcoal-navy rounded feet. One hand rests by its side, the other reaches outward gently to plead its case. Charming but restrained.
Style/medium: minimal premium matte resin 3D designer toy, softly beveled surfaces, subtle warm studio light and delicate ambient occlusion. Cream/off-white and charcoal navy palette. Face remains legible on an ivory body. Same visual family as reference.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered mostly front view, subtle three-quarter depth, full body including open lid, earbuds, arms and feet entirely visible, generous 12 percent empty margins. Character fills about 75 percent canvas height.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, no environment, no floor or opaque backdrop, no checkerboard.
Constraints: no separate additional characters. No words, lettering, logos, watermark, courtroom furniture, frame, pedestal, costume or accessories. No giant white eyes, thin stick arms, gloves, thick black outlines, exaggerated grin, shiny plastic, complicated texture. Render only the complete earbud-case mascot as a clean transparent PNG cutout.
